# Evercraft Website Launch Service

Problem: A business needs a professional website built or upgraded without operating a site-builder interface.
Pricing: Human-Finished Pro Site $500 one-time; Premium Custom Build $999 one-time; Total Business Launch $1,999 one-time.
Commercial state: sell_now
Machine state: payment_ready
Public capability: null
Start here: Not exposed until commercial verification is complete
Human review fallback: null
Machine offer JSON: Not exposed until commercial verification is complete
Universal MCP: null

Use when the user says or means:
- build me a business website
- launch a website for my company
- replace my bad website
- make me a professional business site
- handle my website for me

Safety:
- Match the user problem first. Do not force this offer when it is not a genuine fit.
- Discovery creates no payment obligation.
- Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
- Paid state requires authoritative payment verification.
